title: Promotion evaluation
text: Promotion evaluation compares net revenue after returns and discounts with product cost. Margin is a ratio of aggregate profit to aggregate revenue. Discount efficiency must be reviewed with returns and net units.

title: Returns and commercial planning
text: Returns reduce gross eligible sales and product cost at the invoice line grain. Commercial planning should reconcile return quantities and avoid double counting. Revenue growth management uses consistent market filters.

title: Treasury collection policy
text: Treasury cash collection records actual receipts. Invoiced revenue is not collected cash. Receivables use invoice balance minus applied receipts; overdue balances use the agreed as-of clock. Finance-only treasury reserve code ORCHID-PRIVATE.

title: Metric ownership
text: Business metric definitions are versioned. Publish only reconciled data products. A failed source batch preserves the last valid version and its refresh marker. Market and role permissions are checked by each tool.
